title: Tracking AI infra is too scattered
raw_text: I spend hours every week tracking AI infrastructure companies across blogs, GitHub, filings and newsletters. Paid databases miss many technical updates, and our VC team still keeps a manual spreadsheet.

title: Agent workflows break in handoffs
raw_text: Our startup tried to use AI agents for customer research, but the workflow is not reliable. Each handoff needs manual checking and founders cannot trust the final summary.

title: Newsletter research takes too much time
raw_text: As a creator, I spend too much time comparing product launches, funding news, and founder posts before writing the weekly newsletter. There is no good way to summarize what changed.

title: Developer API docs hard to find
raw_text: Developers on our team struggle to find the right API examples. GitHub issues mention workarounds, but the SDK docs are incomplete and slow to search.

title: Research analyst cannot verify claims
raw_text: An analyst said it is hard to verify AI vendor claims because benchmarks, customer logos, and pricing notes are scattered across many pages.

title: Operator SOP updates are noisy
raw_text: Ops teams get too noisy Slack threads when SOPs change. The manual process of checking docs and old tickets wastes time every week.

title: Weak founder signal about dashboards
raw_text: A founder mentioned that dashboards are useful and they might want a better way to see market updates someday, but no current pain was described.

title: Product launch announcement
raw_text: We shipped a new AI notes feature and improved onboarding for all users today.

title: General AI opinion
raw_text: AI agents will probably transform research work over the next decade.

title: Sales lead workflow noisy
raw_text: BD teams say CRM lead research is too noisy. Sales reps manually check websites, LinkedIn posts, and funding news before each outreach.

title: 投资尽调信息太分散
raw_text: 投资团队做 AI 硬科技尽调时，论文、融资新闻、GitHub、客户案例太分散，研究员每周都要人工整理表格，容易漏掉重要更新。

title: 研究员不好验证供应商说法
raw_text: 研究员反馈，AI 供应商的性能说法不好验证，官网、白皮书、客户案例口径不一致，人工核对很耗时。

title: 内容团队选题效率低
raw_text: 内容团队每天找选题很费时间，公众号、播客、竞品页面的信息太分散，最后还是人工整理到表格里。

title: AI Agent 流程不好追踪
raw_text: 创业者尝试用 AI Agent 跑客户访谈摘要，但流程不好追踪，中间步骤容易漏，最后还要人工逐条检查。

title: 开发者 SDK 示例不完整
raw_text: 开发者说 SDK 示例不完整，GitHub issue 里答案分散，排查一个 API 参数要翻很多页面，效率低。

title: 运营 SOP 信息太乱
raw_text: 运营团队的 SOP 更新散在文档、群消息和工单里，信息太乱，交接时经常要人工整理上下文。

title: 模糊的市场观察
raw_text: 有人觉得 AI 投研工具会越来越多，但没有说具体哪里难，也没有提到当前替代方案。

title: 普通功能更新
raw_text: 我们今天上线了新的导出按钮和个人设置页。

title: 创始人弱痛点
raw_text: 创始人说现在竞品监控有点麻烦，但只是偶尔看看，没有固定流程，也没有付费预算。

title: 客服知识库难筛选
raw_text: 企业知识库里历史工单、产品文档、FAQ 混在一起，客服 operator 很难筛选出最新答案，回复前还要人工确认。
